/color/tokens/bg/usage: Moon white. The page background, equivalent to the iOS grouped background; all cards and lists float on it.
/color/tokens/surface/usage: Porcelain white. The surface for cards, list groups, and sheets, set on top of bg.
/color/tokens/surface-sunken/usage: Cloud gray. Recessed areas such as input fills and segmented control tracks.
/color/tokens/surface-hover/usage: The fill for rows and menu items when hovering over surface. Appears only on devices with a mouse.
/color/tokens/surface-raised/usage: Small raised pieces: the selected block of a segmented control, a stepper button on hover. By day it matches surface and lifts by its shadow; at night the shadow can’t be seen, so it sits one step lighter than surface-sunken.
/color/tokens/ink/usage: Blue-black. Titles and body text; usable on bg, surface, and surface-sunken.
/color/tokens/ink-secondary/usage: Slate. Secondary text and values on the right side of list rows; usable on bg, surface, and surface-sunken.
/color/tokens/ink-tertiary/usage: Smoke gray. Placeholders, footnotes, and timestamps; usable on bg, surface, and surface-sunken.
/color/tokens/hairline/usage: Plain rule. The divider between list rows; decorative only and carries no meaning.
/color/tokens/border-control/usage: Control borders and the off-state track of switches; at least 3:1 on bg, surface, and surface-sunken.
/color/tokens/tint/usage: Azurite. The only interaction color in the system: primary buttons, links, selected states, and switches in the on state. When used as text, usable on bg, surface, and tint-wash.
/color/tokens/tint-hover/usage: The fill of tint-filled buttons on hover; on-tint still sits on top.
/color/tokens/on-tint/usage: Text and icons on a tint fill.
/color/tokens/tint-wash/usage: Azurite wash. The background for secondary buttons, selected rows, and info messages, with tint or ink text on top.
/color/tokens/seal/usage: Cinnabar, for text and lines: error text and borders, delete items in a menu, the frame and characters of a relief seal. Use only one per screen; usable on bg, surface, and seal-wash. Large fills use seal-fill.
/color/tokens/seal-fill/usage: Cinnabar as a fill: the face of an intaglio seal, numbered badges, delete buttons, the logo. By day it matches seal; at night seal is lightened to work as text and would look bright and pink over a large area, so fills use a deeper cinnabar.
/color/tokens/seal-hover/usage: The fill of seal-fill buttons on hover; on-seal still sits on top.
/color/tokens/on-seal/usage: Text and icons on a seal-fill ground. White in both themes, so an intaglio seal stays white on cinnabar.
/color/tokens/seal-wash/usage: Cinnabar wash. The background for error messages, with seal or ink text on top.
/color/tokens/jade/usage: Bamboo green. Success and completion; always paired with a word or icon, never distinguished by color alone. When used as text, usable on bg, surface, and jade-wash.
/color/tokens/on-jade/usage: Text and icons on a jade fill.
/color/tokens/jade-wash/usage: Bamboo green wash. The background for success messages.
/color/tokens/amber/usage: Gamboge. The fill color for warnings; use only as a fill, not as text on light backgrounds.
/color/tokens/on-amber/usage: Text and icons on an amber fill.
/color/tokens/amber-ink/usage: Warning text and icons; usable on bg, surface, and amber-wash.
/color/tokens/amber-wash/usage: Gamboge wash. The background for warning messages.
/color/tokens/gold/usage: Gold ink. Gold-line accents such as stitches, fret patterns, and title slip borders; also usable for signatures and small text for solar terms, on bg, surface, and surface-sunken. Not for buttons or status.
/color/tokens/pattern/usage: Pattern color. Large-area background patterns such as the wave pattern, drawn on surface or bg; purely decorative, with no text on top.
/color/tokens/focus/usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px, at least 3:1 on all surfaces.
/color/tokens/material/usage: Frosted glass material. The base of navigation bars and tab bars, with a 20px background blur.
/type/note: Sizes come in two runs. Sans-serif text (caption to body) follows the iOS sizes 12, 13, 15, 17, one or two pixels a step. Serif titles start at 17 and multiply by √2 per level (double the area), with a single half step, title-3, in between. Line heights are all multiples of 4, on the same grid as spacing. See the Type section for details.
/type/groups/styles/display/usage: Covers and launch screens; at most one per screen. The only style that grows with the window: 56/64 on medium, 64/72 on wide.
/type/groups/styles/title-1/usage: Page large title, corresponding to the iOS Large Title. Also the title of a long text.
/type/groups/styles/title-2/usage: Card titles, section titles, and dialog titles.
/type/groups/styles/title-3/usage: Small titles: the third heading level in long text, and the title of each item in a set. Below this size, switch from the Song typeface to headline.
/type/groups/styles/display-en/usage: Covers and launch screens for English interfaces, corresponding to display. At most one per screen. 60/64 on medium, 68/72 on wide.
/type/groups/styles/title-1-en/usage: The page large title for English interfaces, corresponding to title-1.
/type/groups/styles/title-2-en/usage: Card titles and section titles for English interfaces, corresponding to title-2.
/type/groups/styles/title-3-en/usage: Small titles for English interfaces, corresponding to title-3.
/type/groups/styles/colophon/usage: English signatures and colophons, italic, replacing the vertical title slip. Use only for signatures, not for emphasis in body text.
/type/groups/styles/headline/usage: Text to emphasize in buttons, navigation bar titles, and list rows.
/type/groups/styles/body/sample: 中文正文的行高比西文多留四分，读起来才不挤。
/type/groups/styles/body/usage: Body text and list row titles.
/type/groups/styles/body-en/usage: English body text, with 4px less line height than the Chinese body. The other sans-serif styles are shared between Chinese and English.
/type/groups/styles/callout/usage: Supporting text, form labels, and segmented controls.
/type/groups/styles/footnote/usage: Footer notes for list groups and timestamps.
/type/groups/styles/caption/usage: Tags, tab bar text, and badges. Single lines only.
/spacing/tokens/space-1/usage: The minimum gap between an icon and text.
/spacing/tokens/space-2/usage: Tag padding and the gap between controls in the same group.
/spacing/tokens/space-4/usage: Page left and right margins and left and right padding in list rows.
/spacing/tokens/space-5/usage: Card padding and left and right button padding.
/spacing/tokens/space-8/usage: White space between a large title and content.
/spacing/tokens/space-12/usage: White space between page sections, also the module for covers.
/radius/tokens/radius-sm/usage: Small icons, thumbnails, and the corner radius of focus rings. Seals do not use it; the seal face has its own cut corners.
/radius/tokens/radius-md/usage: Buttons, input fields, and segmented controls.
/radius/tokens/radius-lg/usage: Cards, list groups, and message bars.
/radius/tokens/radius-full/usage: Tags, switches, and small pill buttons; perfect circles such as moon gates.
/shadow/tokens/shadow-card/usage: Cards. Very light, like paper floating on a desk. At night a black shadow can’t be seen on a dark ground, so it adds a very faint light edge.
/shadow/tokens/shadow-float/usage: Overlays and raised menus. At night it adds the same light edge, so overlays have a boundary.
/shadow/tokens/shadow-thumb/usage: Switch thumbs and the selected block of segmented controls.
/breakpoint/note: Window width has three levels. Variables cannot be used in media queries; copy the values here when writing numeric values.
/breakpoint/tokens/bp-medium/usage: From here up is medium: tablets and narrow browser windows. The grid has 8 columns.
/breakpoint/tokens/bp-expanded/usage: From here up is expanded: desktop browsers. The grid has 12 columns, and the tab bar switches to top navigation or a sidebar.
/breakpoint/tokens/bp-wide/usage: The content area no longer grows wider; the white space on both sides increases.
/layout/tokens/margin-compact/usage: Page left and right margins for narrow screens (under 600px), with a 4-column grid.
/layout/tokens/margin-medium/usage: Page left and right margins for medium screens, with an 8-column grid.
/layout/tokens/margin-expanded/usage: Page left and right margins for wide screens, with a 12-column grid.
/layout/tokens/gutter/usage: Grid column gap; narrow screens use 16px (space-4).
/layout/tokens/content-max/usage: The maximum width of the content area; beyond it, content is centered.
/layout/tokens/measure/usage: The maximum line width for long-form body text, about 38 Chinese characters or 70 English characters.
/zIndex/tokens/z-nav/usage: Sticky navigation bars and fixed bottom tab bars.
/zIndex/tokens/z-popover/usage: Menus and popovers. Higher than dialogs, so they remain visible when opened inside a dialog.
/opacity/tokens/opacity-disabled/usage: Disabled controls drop to this opacity as a whole.
/motion/note: Motion only responds to actions. Exit is one third faster than enter; when the system turns on Reduce Motion, turn it all off.
/motion/tokens/dur-base/usage: Switches, segmented sliders, and tab changes.
/motion/tokens/dur-slow/usage: Dialogs, bottom sheets, and page transitions.
